name: Ivana Horvat
bio:
Ivana Horvat's journey into motorsport began unexpectedly, fuelled by a chance encounter with a local racing team seeking logistical support. Her background in supply chain management proved invaluable, quickly establishing her as a dependable asset. She thrives on the meticulous planning and problem-solving inherent in coordinating complex logistical operations, ensuring that equipment and personnel arrive precisely when and where they're needed. 

Ivana's pragmatic approach is complemented by her innate ability to anticipate potential disruptions and develop contingency plans. She's earned a reputation for her calm demeanor under pressure and her unwavering commitment to minimizing downtime. At Prema Racing, she is known for her relentless pursuit of efficiency and her talent for navigating the intricate regulations of international motorsport logistics. Her dedication to detail and her refusal to compromise on quality have made her an indispensable part of the team's success.

What truly sets Ivana apart is her ability to foster strong relationships with suppliers, customs officials, and transportation providers. She understands that successful logistics is not just about moving things; it's about building trust and collaboration. She sees herself as a facilitator, enabling the team to focus on their core competencies without worrying about the intricacies of international shipping or complex border crossings.

physical.hairStyle: Shoulder-length, neatly styled in a low ponytail with a few strands framing her face.
physical.description: Ivana is of average height with a slender build and a focused gaze.

quirks: Keeps a detailed, color-coded spreadsheet of all logistical movements.
Always carries a small, well-worn Croatian-English dictionary.
Insists on personally inspecting every shipment, no matter how small.
